case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quote and for setting out your cost drivers so openly. We value the reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution that works for both sides.

Our own data shows a somewhat different picture:

Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

We also buy Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled from another source, at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10).

With this in mind, we have prepared three options, each with a longer contract term to give you planning security:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.59; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.43; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.55; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

Each option is meant as a genuine basis for agreement. We look forward to your view and to continuing our partnership.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, the price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company. 

We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract to ensure mutual planning security. For a term of this length, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material fluctuations. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C, and we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Our current offer is a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

With this adjustment, we can offer a unit price of €5.70 at 30 days net, as prices from other sources cannot be directly compared to our offering. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.70 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming the delivery data. We also note your view that the price comparison does not reflect your situation, and we will leave that point aside.

We are glad you share our interest in a longer partnership. All options below include the index clause on alloy surcharge you asked for, so both family companies carry raw material swings fairly over the full term.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.60; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.44; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.56; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

Each option is a genuine offer, and we would be pleased if one of them works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership. We appreciate your inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause, which provides necessary stability for a 24-month term. However, your proposed price increase of EUR 0.01 is insufficient for us to make further concessions. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our Angebot is a price of €5.70 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. We value you as a customer and look forward to hearing from you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
